nvitk.db.pipeline_assets¶

Register qvtpy / eICAB pipeline outputs in the assets catalog table.

Supports local results trees (<results>/<subject>/eicab and .../qvtpy) and rows produced by nvitk.db.xnat_pipeline_resources from XNAT experiment resources with the same labels (eicab, qvtpy).
